## Description {#details}

<p>This helper class is used to match scalar and vector constants that satisfy a specified predicate, and bind them to an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/apfloat">APFloat</a>.</p>


<p>Poison is allowed in splat vector constants.</p>


<p>Definition at line 440 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/patternmatch-h">PatternMatch.h</a>.</p>
